title: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Philippine-Korean Community Race
seo_title: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 Review | Pampanga
meta_description: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 review: November 22 at Clark Parade Grounds -- a Philippine-Korean community race in the well-tested Freeport Zone.
dek: Set for 22 November 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this race carries a distinctive Philippine-Korean community branding, run by SMOKE10 Events at the same proven venue hosting several other races in this research batch.
verdict: The Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon's name signals a genuine Philippine-Korean community connection -- a distinctive cultural angle among the races in this research batch, reflecting the significant Korean expatriate and business presence in and around Clark, Pampanga. It's organised by SMOKE10 Events, the same team behind the Isla del Fuego Marathon and Pampanga Marathon covered elsewhere in this research, at Clark Parade Grounds -- a venue with genuine multi-year race-hosting track record. Four distances (3K/5K/10K/21.1K) and open registration make this an accessible, community-oriented pick.

sections.heading: A Philippine-Korean Community Race
paragraphs: The Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon offers four distances -- 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K -- organised by SMOKE10 Events at Clark Parade Grounds. [1] The 'Phil-Kor' name signals a Philippine-Korean community connection, reflecting the significant Korean expatriate, business and tourism presence in the Clark and Angeles City area -- a distinctive cultural angle not seen at any other race in this research batch.

sections.heading: The Same Organiser as Two Other Races
paragraphs: SMOKE10 Events also organises the Isla del Fuego Marathon on Siquijor and the annual Pampanga Marathon, both covered elsewhere in this research batch. [1] That gives this Clark leg the benefit of an organiser with genuine track record across multiple Philippine destinations, from a small island community race to a long-running regional marathon.

sections.heading: A Proven Freeport Zone Venue
paragraphs: Clark Parade Grounds sits within the former Clark Air Base complex, now part of the redeveloped Clark Freeport and Special Economic Zone -- the same venue hosting the annual Pampanga Marathon (since at least 2022), the Singlife ONE Clark International Marathon, and legs of both the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series and HOKA Midnight Run Asia. [2] That repeat use gives this Phil-Kor leg genuinely tested infrastructure to work with.

sections.heading: Four Distances, Open Registration
paragraphs: Registration is currently open across 3K, 5K, 10K and 21.1K distances -- giving the event broad accessibility for both community participants and more serious half-marathon runners.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a community-oriented race with a distinctive Philippine-Korean cultural angle, run by an experienced organiser at a proven Freeport Zone venue, appeals, the Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon on 22 November 2026 is a solid, accessible pick. Registration is already open.
